title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

reports.title: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say

summary:
On Aug. 3 in Cypress, Texas, Harris County sheriff's deputies mistook two 19-year-old men, Anthony and Julian, for car thieves. Deputies surrounded Anthony's Camaro with at least five patrol cars and a helicopter, pointed guns, handcuffed them, and one deputy threatened to shoot, according to the men. Julian showed cuts and scrapes. Deputies thought the car was a stolen Camaro linked to aggravated robberies after flock cameras picked up plates, but they could not read the plates on the car they stopped.

After handcuffing the men, deputies realized it was the wrong car and showed them a picture of the stolen vehicle. The men were not charged. Anthony's mother plans to hire an attorney and wants deputies held accountable. The sheriff's office says supervisors will review body-worn camera footage to check procedures. The men were given information on filing a formal complaint with internal affairs, and both plan to do so.
title_en: 'I'm going to shoot you': 2 men held at gunpoint before deputies realize their mistake, victims say
